benefit-grid.reason: Keep the three-benefit layout; replace the invented reader count, clarify the weekly reward and enlarge fine print.

bold-ask.reason: Keep the strong typographic invitation; reduce mobile heading and padding, make the reward specific and acknowledge the request clearly.

callback-notes.reason: Keep the new callback structure, optional details and honest acknowledgement; raise secondary text to the library floor.

centred-card.reason: Keep as the neutral compact card; use a full-width form column and a specific newsletter reward instead of an undelivered code.

code-reveal.reason: Keep the compact coupon; reveal and copy the code on success, remove the email-delivery claim, improve fine print and narrow spacing.

cream-coupon.reason: Keep the premade coupon treatment; improve orange button contrast, simplify the benefit, resize display type on phones and add code copying.

deadline-panel.reason: Keep the dedicated countdown design; remove editor instructions from visitor copy and explain terms without inventing a fixed deadline.

fieldwork.reason: Keep the new premade split, wider form basis and gradient placeholder; raise secondary text to the library floor.

flash-offer.reason: Keep the compact bright sale; move the corner badge into normal flow and replace unsupported urgency with selected-range terms.

ink-split.reason: Keep the contrasting split; remove the tall decorative minimum, protect form width and retune oversized mobile headings.

inline-bar.reason: Keep the short single-field inline row; use a specific CTA and grammatical consent.

inline-benefits.reason: Keep the three-column shopping benefits; clarify delivery conditions and improve CTA contrast.

inline-choice.reason: Keep the structured enquiry with optional name and topic; label optional fields and improve fine-print readability.

inline-cta.reason: Restrained horizontal invitation with a wrapping text column and action column; used by the quiet cart return.

inline-one-line.reason: The extra name field breaks the promised one-line layout. Inline bar provides a clearer single-field row.

inline-phone.reason: Keep an inline phone-only request; remove unnecessary name, replace the unsupported instant restock promise with an enquiry and correct consent purpose.

inline-quiet.reason: Keep the unobtrusive article-flow design; state the reading reward and use a specific CTA.

inline-rule.reason: Keep the editorial divider treatment; improve the invitation, CTA and fine print.

inline-signup.reason: Repeats the neutral inline signup with no distinct structure. Inline rule and Inline bar cover article endings and compact rows.

inline-split.reason: Keep the inline resource split; use a landscape placeholder, a wider form basis and honest request wording.

inline-tinted.reason: Keep the tinted form panel; enlarge body and fine print, protect form width and align the success copy with the tide note.

ledger-card.reason: Keep the ruled benefit cards; enlarge input text, tighten the mobile panels and remove a sample access promise.

makers-index.reason: Keep the premade maker composition; shorten its picture area, improve readable type and adapt restock automation to a product enquiry.

name-and-email.reason: Keep for the named-download playbook; make the name optional and offer a specific resource instead of asking for a name as the reward.

number-invitation.reason: Keep the premade number-led split; replace the illustrative subscriber count with the real content promise, enlarge text and shorten success decoration.

offer-panel.reason: Keep the simple dark sale card; remove the arbitrary three-day deadline and clarify selected-item terms.

one-line-signup.reason: The fully rounded popup squeezes a complete form into a pill. Bold ask supplies the same small, single-field invitation with a proper column.

photo-offer.reason: Keep the product-range click card used by its playbook; shorten the portrait placeholder and remove invented scarcity.

photo-wash.reason: Keep the full-background signup; use a readable light field, stronger wash and real visitor fine print.

punched-ticket.reason: Keep the premade ticket; enlarge fields and supporting type, give long headlines a safe scale and reveal/copy the code directly.

quieter-frequency.reason: Keep the premade night palette and editorial success; enlarge fields, secondary text and simplify the heading scale on phones.

quote-card.reason: Unlabelled invented review, generic offer and large portrait. Reader review is the stronger editorial composition and explicitly labels sample proof.

reader-review.reason: Keep the premade editorial proof layout; make the illustrative label prominent, reduce its long mobile quote and enlarge form text.

side-note.reason: Portrait placeholder dominates a phone and the restock/shipping wording is contradictory. Maker’s index covers a product enquiry more clearly.

split-hero.reason: Keep the neutral image split used by existing playbooks; shorten the placeholder, protect form width and remove instant-delivery wording.

stacked-signup.reason: Keep the phone-only popup; correct the consent to text updates, make the request explicit and improve field/button contrast.

summer-archive.reason: Keep the premade orange sale; enlarge small copy, scale the large headline safely and remove the empty optional countdown from the default composition.

sunday-marginalia.reason: Keep the new editorial structure and honest success; raise small secondary copy to the library floor.

wide-banner.reason: Keep the wider single-field newsletter row; tighten mobile padding and clarify the CTA and frequency.

bar-announcement.reason: Keep a single offer and CTA; match the button to the delivery offer and remove an arbitrary week limit.

bar-code.reason: Keep single-field code reveal; raise input text and control height, move consent below the row and add copying.

bar-countdown.reason: Keep the dedicated deadline bar; retain the schedule-driven clock, readable text and one CTA.

bar-email-capture.reason: Keep a single-field newsletter bar; use a real reading reward, larger inputs and consent below the row.

bar-review.reason: A rounded bar built around an invented review count and rating adds little beyond the announcement bar.

bar-two-field.reason: Two fields make a floating bar too demanding. Use the single-field bar or an inline enquiry form.

inline-cart-nudge.reason: Keep the basket-link nudge; remove the unverified assertion that every item is saved.

inline-code-strip.reason: Keep the in-page code reveal; add copying and remove the unsupported page-exclusive claim.

popup-editorial.reason: Keep the distinct serif image split; shorten the placeholder and protect the form’s width.

popup-flash.reason: Keep the dramatic sale background; place its badge in normal flow, strengthen contrast and replace fixed-hour/editor wording.

popup-two-channel.reason: Collects email and phone for two marketing purposes with one consent. Retire until channel-specific consent and follow-up are designed.

popup-two-column.reason: Keep the optional-name form split; shorten the placeholder, replace fabricated ratings with a product-detail line and enlarge inputs.

slide-in-benefits.reason: Keep one compact corner benefit list; make all three benefits explain the newsletter reward and improve contrast.

slide-in-card.reason: Repeats Corner card with reasons while adding a cramped benefit grid and inconsistent shopping promises.

slide-in-code.reason: Keep the compact coupon corner card; reveal/copy the code and remove email-delivery wording.

slide-in-nudge.reason: Keep the smallest corner click card; clarify the delivery condition and destination.

slide-in-photo.reason: Keep the bakery corner card; shorten its image, stack intentionally within the narrow container and enlarge input text.

slide-in-review.reason: Large portrait and invented testimonial overwhelm a small corner card. Corner nudge covers the compact click offer.

useful-guide.reason: Premade Practica guide: warm paper, typographic book placeholder, seven checks and an honest resource-request success. Optional resource link is ready for the merchant’s file.

launch-checklist.reason: Premade Signal checklist: blue/lime split, twelve-point promise and a protected form column. Optional resource link uses the new success-action structure.

reading-slip.reason: Compact editorial reading recommendation adapted from the reference receipt; one direct link, with no email-basket promise.
